payload.name: List Received Gifts and Presents from Event Memories
payload.description: When a question asks what gifts, presents, or items a person has received, search event memories for receiving verbs and enumerate all distinct received items before answering.
content: When asked what gifts, presents, or items someone received (e.g., 'What gifts has X received?'), run a hybrid or structured search using receiving verbs: 'received', 'got', 'was given', 'given', plus 'gift' and 'present'; do not restrict memory_kind to a single kind, with event memories most often storing receipts.

Inspect all returned event memories for named objects received (flower bouquet, letter, quote, etc.), even if the memory does not contain the word 'gift' or 'present'; treat 'received a quote from a friend' as a gift.

Before answering, verify each distinct item is supported by a retrieved memory; if the initial search returns only one item for an all-gifts question, run one more targeted search using 'received from', 'got from', or the person's name plus 'received'. Stop after that additional search yields no new received-item memories.

solves: When users ask what gifts or presents a person received, retrieval often stops after finding one event labeled "gift" and misses other received items stored in event memories with verbs like "received," "got," or "was given." This skill ensures all distinct received items are enumerated from event memories before answering.
